request_trace.user:
Generate a complete, production-ready JMeter JMX test plan.

## API Endpoints
GET /products - List products with pagination and filters (params: page, limit, category, status)
POST /products - Create a product (admin only) [body: application/json]
GET /products/{id} - Get product by ID (params: id)
PUT /products/{id} - Update a product (admin only) (params: id) [body: application/json]
DELETE /products/{id} - Delete a product (admin only) (params: id)
GET /cart/items - List current user's cart items
POST /cart/items - Add product to cart (merge and accumulate quantity if exists) [body: application/json]
PUT /cart/items/{itemId} - Update cart item quantity (params: itemId) [body: application/json]
DELETE /cart/items/{itemId} - Remove cart item (params: itemId)
GET /orders - List current user's orders (params: page, limit, status)
POST /orders - Create order from cart (requires non-empty cart, decrements stock) [body: application/json]
GET /orders/{id} - Get order by ID (owner only) (params: id)
POST /orders/{id}/cancel - Cancel an unpaid order (params: id)

## Configuration
- Virtual Users: 100
- Duration: 300 seconds
- Ramp-Up: 60 seconds
- Think Time: 500 ms
- Base URL: https://api.example.com
- Auth: none

## Requirements
1. Complete XML from <?xml ...?> to </jmeterTestPlan>
2. ThreadGroup with configured users/ramp-up/duration (ramp-up then steady state)
3. HTTP Request Defaults (server + port from Base URL), Cookie Manager, Cache Manager
4. HTTP Header Manager with Content-Type: application/json (and Authorization when Auth != none)
5. HTTP Samplers for EACH listed endpoint with realistic request bodies (from schema) for POST/PUT
6. Response Assertions for success status codes AND at least one key field
7. If Auth != none: a login sampler that extracts a token (JSON Extractor / Regular Expression Extractor) and reuses it via a Header Manager for subsequent samplers
8. Summary Report and Simple Data Writer listeners
9. (Cleanup) if any sampler creates data, add a teardown step that deletes it

Output ONLY raw JMX XML. Start with: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
